title: Improper access control on account export endpoint
reproduction_steps: Send authenticated request with low-privilege session token to /api/v1/accounts/export?format=json.
remediation: Enforce role-based authorization and tenant ownership checks server-side.

title: Reflected parameter echo in diagnostic query
reproduction_steps: Pass harmless marker string into trace parameter and observe response body reflection.
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and strict allowlist validation.
